false_negative_root_cause: scripts/qsb_env.sh activates /vaults/nvme0/qsb_tower_v1/.venv which contains its own Python 3.12 with no PyQt5. PyQt5 is installed only in the system Python at /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/PyQt5. The previous health check sourced qsb_env.sh, so its `python3 -c 'import PyQt5'` ran inside the venv and naturally failed.
fix_applied: Health check now probes the system Python (/usr/bin/python3) for PyQt5 — that is the interpreter the cockpit actually uses.
qsb_native_cockpit_run.sh exports QSB_PY=/usr/bin/python3 and uses it for native_cockpit/qt/main.py.
qsb_native_cockpit_run.sh still sources qsb_env.sh for PYTHONPATH to src/, but flips python interpreter for the GUI process.
Health check tests the actual chosen engine (PyQt5) — not PySide6/Panda3D/Godot since those are not the chosen engine.
